meta.description: IPL 2026 squads plus every player sold or unsold at the IPL 2024, 2025 (mega) and 2026 auctions.
meta.ratingsNote: bat/bowl ratings are editorial T20 estimates on a 1-99 scale, not official figures. Edit freely.
meta.basePriceNote: basePriceLakh is the player's IPL 2026 auction base price where they were in that auction; otherwise a slab derived from rating.
meta.price2026Note: price2026Lakh is the player's IPL 2026 contract price: 2025 retention, 2025 auction (or replacement fee), 2026 trade fee, or 2026 auction price. Null for players not in a 2026 squad.
